title: Live safeguarded-Newton recovery from a physically consistent B4 overshoot
question: Can P4 recover a genuinely bad live E3 physical-Newton proposal caused by real B4 nonlinearity, while the groundwater merit oracle itself is independently adequate and no tangent/numerical tolerance is degraded?

derivation.rationale: Choose a live storage-dominated response using the already measured G10 r≈0.5 slope so q_gw equals the known B4 q_swap at dh=-1e-5. From the frozen href state, the previously measured physical E3 tangent then predicts a Newton overshoot past the known negative edge.

groundwater_oracle.fit: ordinary affine least-squares q_gw(H)=aH+b over all five fresh constant-flux probes

reference_contract.target_check: The live residual magnitude at the frozen dh=-1e-5 edge must be <=5e-13 m/s; otherwise classify STRESS_CALIBRATION_MISSED and do not retune.
reference_contract.root_method: Search only the unchanged G10 fixed scan status-0 heads plus the frozen target edge. If a sign-changing admissible pair exists without crossing a sampled status-6 point, bisect. Otherwise convergence is judged by coupled residual only and the target-edge calibration remains diagnostic.

policies.P1_E3: Raw physical Newton with unchanged G09D E3 at every accepted iterate.
policies.P4_E3: Same E3 proposal with unchanged factor-1/2 backtracking until participant status is 0 and coupled-residual magnitude does not increase.

required_gates: Groundwater affine fit error <=1e-16 m/s and slope >0.
The frozen target-edge residual satisfies the preregistered <=5e-13 m/s calibration gate; no head-bias retuning is allowed.
The first raw P1/P4 proposal from href is identical before safeguarding and lies at dh<-1e-5 m.
That raw proposal is either participant-inadmissible or increases the adequate groundwater-merit residual relative to href.
P4 performs at least one factor-1/2 contraction and converges within 12 outer iterations.
P1 outcome is recorded but P1 failure is not required if the raw first proposal is demonstrably bad.
Every diagnostic SWAP trial is discarded and revision/time/ledger remain at immutable origin.
interpretation_rules: A PASS is bounded evidence that the unchanged P4 safeguard can recover a live bad physical-Newton proposal in this B4 stress regime.
Failure to trigger the safeguard is a falsification of this stress design, not permission to retune the head bias post hoc.
G10 remains falsified and G10B remains separately qualified.
No production HCOF/RHS or coupling-source change follows from G11.
